items.name: Burnout is tied to a specific job or situation
Depression shows up across life as a whole
Improving with rest points to burnout
Worthlessness or thoughts of death need help now

closing.headline: Check whether the struggle is limited to work, or spans life as a whole.
closing.tip: Note whether you actually recover after taking time off.
closing.cta: If there's worthlessness or thoughts of death, contact a professional without delay.
